feed.title: Verilay Patchmap: Kernel and drivers on Windows Server 2016

entry.title: Now fixed: USB audio devices might fail to start or produce no sound
entry.summary: Started with KB5123099. Fixed in KB5131291. Affects: Windows Server 2016. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/release-health/status-windows-10-1607-and-windows-server-2016#4984msgdesc. From Microsoft release health.
